6.32 Repairing the distinctions that a comparison can
lose
The unresolved comparisons in the preceding section do not all describe the same prob-
lem. A circular may contain a supported duty about advertisements while the selected
program decides whether a gift is prohibited. Reporting that the gift formula does not
implement the advertising duty is accurate as a description of the formula, but it has
not identified a defect in that formula. The bank still needs to account for the adver-
tising duty elsewhere. Conversely, an exception to the gift prohibition belongs in the
gift decision even if an earlier reader called it background. A useful comparison must
distinguish these two situations before proposing a repair.
Round 16 implements four separate judgments. The first asks whether the extracted
proposition is supported by the supplied source. The second asks whether that propo-
sition affects the exact question assigned to the program. The third compares the propo-
sition with the actual executable expression. The fourth records the availability of any
authority needed to decide the matter. Each judgment has its own reason. Source
support and question relevance carry source quotations; a proposed preservation or
contradiction of executable meaning also carries an exact quotation from the rendered
expression. The question includes the actor, unit of assessment, temporal basis and
meanings of true and false. Its content hash prevents an assessment of one question
from being reused after the question changes.
Consider an illustrative circular containing both an advertising disclosure duty and a
gift restriction. The disclosure duty may be recorded as supported by the source, not ap-
plicable to the gift question, and consequently not applicable to the gift formula. That
combination no longer needs a fictitious formalization failure to satisfy the response
schema. The claim–reading pair nevertheless remains in the inventory, with its rea-
soned relation available for challenge. If another reader finds that the disclosure para-
graph qualifies the gift restriction, the system retains both proposals and requests an-
other investigation. Agreement on a relevance label does not establish that no distant
qualification has been missed.
An omitted exception has a different diagnosis: the source proposition is supported, its
relation to the gift question is relevant, and the expression omits it. A falsely extracted
proposition has a different starting point again. If a reader says that no electronic cer-
tificate is required while the retained footnote states a certificate requirement, the ex-
tracted proposition must be challenged before its supposed requirement is translated
into code. A missing external definition can leave authority availability unresolved even
when the program faithfully preserves the words already supplied. The new contract
keeps these observations separate and rejects a claimed preservation when the declared
question and the expression have opposite result meanings.
Migration cannot recover these distinctions retrospectively. The 140 accepted round-
15 comparisons used a combined label, and their reasons do not constitute four newly
validated judgments. The migration therefore stores each complete old assessment,
its provenance and its hash, while marking the new dimensions unassessed. All 232

encoding. No new model call or new source judgment was made in this round. The
new interface is an explicit versioned path; older experiments retain the old contract so
that their recorded outcomes remain reproducible.
The reconciliation procedure does not choose a winner by majority. It retains the pro-
posals and identifies the dimensions on which they disagree. Missing authority, an
unassessed relation, a contradicted source proposition or an omission can request fur-
ther processing even when two readers share the same diagnosis. The caller supplies an
attempt number within a fixed maximum. Before that maximum, an unresolved case
requests repair; at the maximum, it produces an explicit uncertainty report. This pro-
cedure supplies a bounded control for investigation. It neither supplies new evidence
by itself nor consumes a model call without an authorized execution route.
6.32.1 What had happened, and what the bank knew
The contact example requires two clocks. Suppose the bank asks at noon whether con-
tact has occurred for STR S. A contact at 11:00 can answer that factual question pos-
itively; a contact at 13:00 cannot. There is also a knowledge cutoff: an 11:00 contact
entered into the system at 13:00 was not available to a replay restricted to information
recorded by noon. A contact about STR T provides no witness for STR S. Compressing
any of these distinctions into one supplied Boolean can make the rule appear correct
while its input answers a different question.
The implemented event projection receives an event identity, an STR identity, an event
kind, the occurrence time, the recording time, evidence identities and whether the event
is confirmed or disputed. The caller states the start of the interval being examined,
the assessment instant and the knowledge cutoff. A confirmed event counts only if it
belongs to the specified report, falls in the stated occurrence interval and was recorded
by the knowledge cutoff. The by-now interval includes the assessment instant. This is
the chosen factual question; it introduces no deadline into the circular.
A positive answer can have a particular event as its witness. A negative answer requires
more: a separately supplied assertion that the history is complete for the report, event
kind and whole interval being assessed. That assertion has its own recording time and
evidence. Without an eligible completeness assertion, absence produces an unknown
result. An assertion recorded before the end of the interval cannot certify its future
portion. A relevant disputed event produces conflict, and two incompatible records
using the same event identity are rejected. These checks make the reliance on event
recording visible; they cannot establish that an operational source captured every real
contact.
Resubmission adds another relation. The resubmission event names the original sub-
mission, and that original must belong to the same STR. A missing original leaves the
linkage unresolved. The adapter rejects an attributed resubmission that predates its
original. A complete history with no linked resubmission can support a negative an-
swer to this factual existence question; it does not by itself decide whether the legal

wise remain different from the intention that triggers their associated duties.
The source’s effective interval and the generated bundle’s interval are kept separately
from these two clocks. Round 16 re-executes the nine retained child cases without
changing their bundles. The three historical assessments still return the version-time
refusal because their requested dates precede the stored bundle intervals. The added
time-context check records that refusal separately from unresolved source effectiveness.
An explicitly supplied effectiveness assertion needs source anchors and an interval be-
fore it can produce even a conditional applicability result. The code has not supplied the
missing legal date. A pair of trigger and performance records also retains unencoded
performance instead of reporting overall compliance from a true trigger.
6.32.2 An exact number must survive the Java entry point
Equation 6.10 depends on a positive denominator. Testing that identity inside the rule
evaluator does not protect an external interface that accepts arbitrary numerator and
denominator fields. Round 16 adds a packaged Java entry point which accepts the dec-
imal percentage itself. Its request declares the signed exact-percentage profile, subject,
assessment and knowledge times, development mode and three facts: fund-manager
status, the stated virtual-asset objective, and intended percentage exposure. The gener-
ated entry point supplies the internal rational fields. It rejects a caller who also tries to
supply those fields, a raw snapshot or other undeclared fields.
The percentage is a decimal string in percentage units. Thus "10" means 10%, while
"0.1" means one tenth of one percent. Suppose its signed unscaled integer is u and it
has s decimal places. Java computes the integer numerator 100u and the positive de-
nominator 10s, then divides both by their greatest common divisor. The policy receives
that reduced exact ratio in basis points. At 9.999%, the initial pair is 999900 and 1000,
which reduces to 9999 and 10. The comparison remains false because 9999 is less than
10000. No binary floating-point representation or rounding rule intervenes. Python
provides a separate reference conversion using rational arithmetic.
The accepted syntax has an optional minus sign, an ordinary integer part and an op-
tional nonempty decimal part, within a 64-character limit. Exponents, whitespace, re-
dundant leading zeroes, non-ASCII digits, nonfinite values and JSON numeric inputs
are rejected. Very fine decimal scales remain exact when they fit the limit. A missing
percentage is converted to missing rational facts; a conflicting percentage supplies con-
flicting facts. Their eventual effect follows the declared RuleIR uncertainty semantics.
For example, the retained case with no virtual-asset objective and a missing percentage
returns unknown, while conflicting percentage evidence blocks a known result.
Signed input is an explicit arithmetic profile inherited from the earlier rational exper-
iment. Acceptance of a negative number under this profile is not a decision that neg-
ative intended exposure is permissible for a particular fund question. A deployment
must state its financial domain separately. The new package is also an explicit interface
choice: existing raw-snapshot APIs remain available for their earlier purposes and do

generated percentage entry point. Its build record binds that class, the actual JAR, the

Thirty retained host cases exercise this JAR and the Python reference. They include all
seven earlier threshold examples, additional fine-scale and signed values, missing and
conflicting facts, malformed strings and direct attempts to inject denominators. Sev-
enteen requests are rejected as specified; the other thirteen agree on the transformed
snapshot and the full decision content apart from the declared engine identity and its
associated hash. Separate focused checks send a floating-point JSON number directly to
Java, avoiding the misleading possibility that Python alone rejects it before the JAR sees
the request. These results establish the tested representation boundary; the qualifying-
asset classifications supplied to the rule still need their own evidence.
6.32.3 One downloaded file can contain incompatible editions
The acquired 23EC44 appendix pack supplies a concrete source-selection test. Its clean
October 2023 terms occupy Appendix 7, PDF pages 74–94. Appendix 7a, pages 95–135,
shows amendments and can yield old and replacement wording in the same extracted
stream. The new selection manifest binds the original PDF, each extracted page, both
edition ranges and the exact selected provisions. An active source packet requires a
clean edition; attempting to select marked changes as the active edition is rejected. Mix-
ing provisions from the two editions is rejected even though both came from the same
genuine download.
Selection within the clean edition must preserve qualifications as well. The executed
example takes the definitions on page 76, the footnote about the structure of the collec-
tive investment scheme, the continuation on page 77 about persistent price appreciation
and notification, and the application paragraphs on that page. The manifest explicitly
links these provisions. Selecting the definitions while omitting the declared footnote or
continuation fails with a missing-dependency result. Each excerpt has a page and exact
character offsets; changed source bytes, changed extracted text or a changed manifest
invalidate the earlier selection.
These structural checks operate on an inspected manifest. They do not discover every
legally relevant qualification automatically. The packet therefore keeps unresolved au-
thority questions as unresolved dependencies. The file also carries a notice that the
circular was superseded and updated in December 2023; the printed October date can-
not establish current applicability. The program records the clean historical edition
and leaves effectiveness unresolved. This separates successful acquisition and selection
from the further task of determining which provisions govern a particular assessment
date.
The local repairs narrow identifiable opportunities for error while leaving the earlier
evidence intact. No restored pair, retained parent, source question or unresolved PDF-
materiality identity is removed. The next investigation can use the separate judgments,
attributed event questions, exact Java input and explicit edition packet to ask better-
